::: {#exr-08-p-values-and-effect-sizes-interactive}
## p-values and effect sizes, interactive

Select the statements that are true. Then press **Check**.

```{=html}
<div class="grc-ex" data-type="pick">
<script type="application/json">
{
 "options": [
  {
   "t": "A p-value is the probability of data at least this extreme, assuming no real effect",
   "ok": true
  },
  {
   "t": "Report the effect size together with p",
   "ok": true
  },
  {
   "t": "With n = 24,000, p < .001 can go with a difference of 0.4 percentage points",
   "ok": true
  },
  {
   "t": "A tiny p-value proves a large effect",
   "ok": false
  },
  {
   "t": "A survey correlation licenses the word \"because\"",
   "ok": false
  }
 ],
 "explain": "Significance is not size: the same small difference becomes significant with a large enough sample, and only the experiment's design licenses because.",
 "ref": "sec-08-analysis",
 "reflabel": "Analysis"
}
</script>
</div>
```
:::
